mapper.select: select co.id, co.name, co.credit, co.course_task_id, co.course_assign_id, t.name as teacher_name, t.job_no as teacher_job_no, cg.name as classgroup_name, cg.code as classgroup_code from course co join teacher t on t.id = co.course_task_id join classgroup cg on cg.id = co.course_assign_id where co.id = #{id}

select co.id, co.name, co.credit, co.course_task_id, co.course_assign_id, t.name as teacher_name, t.job_no as teacher_job_no, cg.name as classgroup_name, cg.code as classgroup_code from course co join teacher t on t.id = co.course_task_id join classgroup cg on cg.id = co.course_assign_id order by co.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into course(name, credit, course_task_id, course_assign_id) values(#{name}, #{credit}, #{courseTaskId}, #{courseAssignId})
